beforeShellExecution.command: sh -lc 'command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); node "$root/.cursor/hooks/afk-git-guard.mjs"'
beforeShellExecution.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$gitCommand = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $gitCommand) { exit 0 }; $root = (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null); if (-not $root) { $root = (Get-Location).Path }; node (Join-Path $root '.cursor/hooks/afk-git-guard.mjs')"
